Sandbox_NR_Mode_tooltip: Managed: vanilla's hunger, thirst and fatigue rates are set to zero when the server starts, and the mod writes those stats once a game minute from its own model, with its effects. Overlay: vanilla's rates and stats stand; the mod tracks nutrients and writes only its effects. Read once at server start: a change takes effect after a restart.
Sandbox_NR_LogLevel_tooltip: How much Nutrition Revamp prints to the server console.
Sandbox_NR_LegacyMirror_tooltip: On: every minute the server writes the vanilla calorie, protein, carbohydrate and lipid stores from the mod's trailing 24 hours, so mods and vanilla code that read those stores (among them the protein store's bonus, which applies to Strength experience only) keep working. Off: the mod leaves those stores alone.
Sandbox_NR_OnsetSpeed_tooltip: Multiplies how fast the slow deficiencies develop and recover: the nutrients that take more than 90 days to reach a clinical deficiency at zero intake, such as folate, vitamins B12, A and D, iodine and magnesium. 1.0 is real time; 30 makes a slow deficiency thirty times faster. Vitamin C, the other fast vitamins, water, caffeine, alcohol, glycogen and sleep are never scaled.
Sandbox_NR_DeficienciesCanKill_tooltip: On: the most severe states drain health until they are treated or the character dies: starvation with the fat reserves gone, long clinical scurvy, beriberi or pellagra, severe dehydration or low blood sodium, and an iron overdose. Off: they never drain health. In Managed mode, hunger and thirst never reach vanilla's lethal top level either way.
Sandbox_NR_ExcessEffectsOn_tooltip: On: an intake above a nutrient's upper limit raises that nutrient's excess level. Off: every excess level reads zero, while the intake is still tracked.
Sandbox_NR_BalanceBonus_tooltip: On: while every tracked nutrient is in its replete band, endurance regeneration and fatigue recovery run 5 percent faster. A game choice with no evidence claimed. Off: no bonus.
Sandbox_NR_Severity_tooltip: Scales every penalty a deficiency or an excess brings: fatigue, mood, sickness, slower healing, heavier bleeding, faster wound infection, colds, body temperature, bruising and Short Sighted. 1.0 is the default; 0 removes them all except the health drains, which Deficiencies can kill controls; 3 triples them. Short Sighted needs 1.0 or more. The few credits (exercise, vitamin C against colds, the balanced-diet bonus) are never scaled.
Sandbox_NR_VisibilityMode_tooltip: How much of each player's nutrition the interface shows. Symptoms: words and icons for everyone, and the exact figures only to a character with the Nutritionist trait. Bands, the default: the nutrient grades and body-fat band for everyone as well. Numbers: every figure for everyone.
Sandbox_NR_RecordKeepDays_tooltip: Delete a player's nutrition record after this many real days without them online; a returning player then starts a fresh record, and the vanilla character is untouched. 0 keeps every record. Counted in real time, because game days pass at each server's own speed.
Sandbox_NR_SexSpecific_tooltip: Off: every character uses the male values wherever the mod indexes by sex (requirements, body-fat bands, alcohol, iron, calcium). On: a female character uses the female values.
Sandbox_NR_StrengthTimeScale_tooltip: The biology clock: 1.0 is one biological day per game day; weekly sets are still counted over 7 game days. It multiplies the per-day growth, detraining, regain and peak-decay rates and shortens the grace days by the same factor. Range 0.25 to 30.
Sandbox_NR_StrengthXPPerSet_tooltip: How much vanilla Strength experience counts as one hard set of training, in XP points per set. Range 50 to 2000.
Sandbox_NR_StrengthIncidentalWeight_tool: The weight on Strength XP earned outside a Fitness exercise (carrying, chopping, combat), relative to the same XP from training. Range 0 to 1.
Sandbox_NR_StrengthCapLevel_tooltip: The untrained natural muscle cap, in bio levels (one bio level is 0.5 kg/m2 of lean mass; level 5 is the untrained average). Caps above about 17.7 are held at the natural muscle limit. Range 12 to 20.
Sandbox_NR_StrengthTraitShare_tooltip: The share of a muscle trait's starting lean-mass difference that moves the set point and the cap, as a fraction. Range 0 to 1.
Sandbox_NR_StrengthYearsToLevel10: Years of perfect training to level 10
Sandbox_NR_StrengthYearsToLevel10_toolti: How many years of perfect training at a biology clock of 1.0 take the untrained average character to Strength 10, in years. Range 1 to 10.
Sandbox_NR_StrengthNeuralMax_tooltip: The most that trained neural drive multiplies strength, as a factor (1.0 is none). Range 1.0 to 1.15.
Sandbox_NR_StrengthNeuralRiseWeeks_toolt: The time constant of the neural factor's rise under training, in weeks. Range 1 to 8.
Sandbox_NR_StrengthNeuralDecayWeeks_tool: The time constant of the neural factor's decay once training has lapsed past its grace days, in weeks. Range 4 to 26.
Sandbox_NR_StrengthNeuralGraceDays_toolt: How many days below the maintenance dose pass before the neural factor starts to decay, in days. Range 0 to 60; a value outside it reads the default.
Sandbox_NR_StrengthNeuralSaturationSets_: The weekly hard sets at which the neural factor rises at its full rate, in sets a week. Range 1 to 12.
Sandbox_NR_StrengthRate_tooltip: A multiplier on the fitted muscle growth rate: 2 builds twice as fast, 0.5 half as fast. Range 0.25 to 4.
Sandbox_NR_StrengthThreshold_tooltip: The weekly hard sets a novice needs before muscle grows, in sets a week; the threshold rises with training status. Range 0.25 to 1.0. A combination that makes the threshold exceed the set cap falls back to the defaults at load.
Sandbox_NR_StrengthThresholdRise_tooltip: How steeply the growth threshold rises with training status, as an exponent (0 is flat). Range 0 to 4. A combination that makes the threshold exceed the set cap falls back to the defaults at load.
Sandbox_NR_StrengthTrainedSetCap_tooltip: The most weekly hard sets that count toward growth in a body at its cap, in sets a week. Range 8 to 30. A combination that makes the threshold exceed the set cap falls back to the defaults at load.
Sandbox_NR_StrengthProteinFull_tooltip: The protein intake at which growth is not held back by protein, in grams per kilogram a day; the lower protein steps scale with it. Range 1.0 to 3.0.
Sandbox_NR_StrengthDeficitZero_tooltip: The daily energy deficit at which a novice's muscle growth stops, in kcal a day (negative). Range -2000 to -200.
Sandbox_NR_StrengthDeficitZeroStatusDrop: How far that deficit limit shrinks toward zero for a body at its cap, as a fraction of the limit. Range 0 to 0.9.
Sandbox_NR_StrengthNoviceDeficitDepth_to: How much further a high-protein novice can grow into a deficit, as a multiple of the deficit limit. Range 0 to 10.
Sandbox_NR_StrengthBalanceGate_tooltip: The share of full growth available at energy balance for a novice, as a fraction (1.0 is all). Range 0.5 to 1.0.
Sandbox_NR_StrengthBalanceGateStatusDrop: How far that share drops for a body at its cap, as a fraction of the share. Range 0 to 0.7.
Sandbox_NR_StrengthSurplusFull_tooltip: The energy surplus at which growth is not held back by energy, as a fraction of daily energy expenditure. Range 0.02 to 0.30.
Sandbox_NR_StrengthSurplusFullStatusDrop: How far that surplus requirement shrinks for a body at its cap, as a fraction of the surplus. Range 0 to 0.9.
Sandbox_NR_StrengthTrainedNeedsSurplus_t: How strongly a body at its cap needs an energy surplus to grow: the option scales the growth available at energy balance by (1 − value × status), so at 1 a body at its cap grows nothing at balance. As a fraction. Range 0 to 1.
Sandbox_NR_LeanLossTrainingProtect_toolt: The share of a deficit's lean-mass loss that training prevents, as a fraction. Range 0 to 0.9.
Sandbox_NR_LeanLossProteinProtect_toolti: The share of a deficit's lean-mass loss that enough protein prevents, as a fraction. Range 0 to 0.9.
Sandbox_NR_LeanLossProtectFloor_tooltip: The share of a deficit's lean-mass loss that no protection prevents, as a fraction of the loss. Range 0 to 0.5.
Sandbox_NR_LeanLossProteinFull_tooltip: The protein intake at which the protein protection of lean mass in a deficit is complete, in grams per kilogram a day. Range 1.2 to 3.0.
Sandbox_NR_StrengthMaintainShare_tooltip: The share of the growth threshold (for muscle) and of the neural saturation sets (for the neural factor) that holds strength without growth; weeks below it count toward detraining. As a fraction. Range 0.1 to 1.0.
Sandbox_NR_StrengthGraceDays_tooltip: How many days of missed training pass before muscle begins to detrain, in days. Range 0 to 60; a value outside it reads the default.
Sandbox_NR_StrengthDetrainHalfLifeWeeks_: The half-life of muscle lost to detraining once the grace days have passed, in weeks. Range 2 to 26.
Sandbox_NR_StrengthDetrainStatusSlowing_: How much a trained body's detraining slows with status, as a multiplier on the half-life per unit of status (0 is none). Range 0 to 4.
Sandbox_NR_StrengthRegainHalfLifeWeeks_t: The half-life of regaining muscle lost below its held peak, in weeks. Range 1 to 26.
Sandbox_NR_StrengthPeakHalfLifeYears_too: The half-life of the body's memory of its peak muscle, in years. Range 0.25 to 20.
